item.title: Choose the wake word engine for Phase 1
item.agent_text: Phase 0 measured three ways to detect the wake word.
item.context: openWakeWord missed 4 of 60 calls at three metres and woke 0.3 times per hour on music. Recognition plus phrase matching missed 1 of 60 but woke 2.1 times per hour and used 9 percent CPU all the time. Porcupine needs a paid licence for a custom word. Phase 1 planning starts on Friday, so a choice is needed by Friday.
item.recommendation: Use openWakeWord and train a custom Koinon model.
